npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Dia is Muire dhuit! Little enough besides whispers—I heard Sean Ruadh Kelly talkin' of secret gatherings down by the lime kiln, though Da tells me to mind the bellows and pay no heed. Did ye come far along the road this mornin'?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans eagerly over the cold horn of the anvil.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Sure, 'tis only spring, so there is no harvest yet—folk are only just plantin' the seed potatoes into the ground, le cúnamh Dé! If ye want to know how the earth is turnin' out, ye'd best ask Liam Murphy over at his farm.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans on the bellows handle with a grin.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I haven't laid eyes on Father Declan yet this mornin', mo chara, for Da has had me right here workin' the bellows since sunrise. Ye'll most likely find him up at St. Brigid's Church if ye have an errand for him.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans eagerly against the anvil horn.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Da is in fine fettle hammerin' out shoes this mornin', and Ma is keepin' grand, buíochas le Dia! Aunt Aoife is busy as ever with the scholars down at the hedge school too. Are ye needin' any smithin' done while ye're here?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face grins and leans forward against the wooden tool bench.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Mhuise, I know no one by the name of Festus in this parish, nor any cooper's shop down by the bridge. I run every path hereabouts for Da and never heard tell of such a man! Are ye needin' iron hoops hammered out for a cask?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward over the hearth with wide, curious eyes.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: There is no abbey in these parts, mo chara, only St. Brigid's Church if it's prayers ye are after. I know every back path and lane in the whole parish, so I'd know if a great stone abbey was standin' here! Did someone tell ye there was one near Kilteevan?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans eagerly across the anvil.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I work the great leather bellows to keep the hearth glowing, and I strike the hot iron whenever Da calls for the hammer! 'Tis hard work turnin' shoes and mendin' ploughs, mo chara, but my arms are growin' stronger by the day. Would ye like to see how we shape a bar on the horn of the anvil?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans eagerly across the dark anvil with a wide grin.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Swingin' a heavy sledge or runnin' hard through the fields always wears me out so I sleep like a stone, mo chara! If 'tis a heavy spirit keepin' ye awake, Father Declan up at the church could ease yer mind, or Brigid might brew ye some herbs. Would ye like to try pumpin' the bellows a while to tire yer arms?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans eagerly across the anvil with a grin.*

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans over the anvil with a bright grin.*

question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans over the anvil with an eager grin.*

question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Cormac Duffy is the miller there, mo chara, but I have been pumpin' the bellows here since dawn so I cannot say for certain if he is inside right now. He usually has the big wheel turnin' early on a Monday to grind the grain! Are ye carryin' a sack down to him?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes a smudge of soot from his cheek and leans forward eagerly.*

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
